install: set -euo pipefail; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; fi; export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; if [ ! -x "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" ] || [ "$("$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "1.4.4" ]; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | BUN_INSTALL="$BUN_INSTALL" bash -s "bun-v1.4.4"; fi; grep -qxF 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra e2e; (cd apps/web && bun install --frozen-lockfile)
